title: 第12章缘，妙不可言
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一夜无眠。

天光破晓时，整座庚辛城已经炸开了锅。

武魂殿偏殿走水的消息，比野火般迅速蔓延过每一条街道。

迈尔斯主教连同另外三名高层，活不见人，死不见尸，连一片衣角都没从火堆里扒出来。

消息传开的速度比风还快。

有人说这是仇家寻仇，也有人说这是天谴报应。一时间众说纷纭。

但无论版本再怎么变，有一点是所有人都心照不宣的——

满城都在庆祝。

茶楼酒肆里的说书的、卖菜的、打铁的，几乎人人脸上都带着几分压抑不住的快意。

这些年被武魂殿压得喘不过气，不，应该说是被迈尔斯才对。

如今那块压在心头的大石头骤然消失，那种轻松感几乎要从骨子里漫出来。

而在这满城喧嚣的尽头，城郊客栈的楼上，却是截然不同的寂静。

古榕坐在窗边，手里端着一杯早已凉透的茶，目光落在对面假寐的青年身上。

即便事情已经过去了整整一夜，他的思绪还是有些无法平静。

昨晚他在暗处看着的。

对付同为魂帝的迈尔斯，这小子全程只用了第一、第二魂技。第二魂技控场，第一魂技锁人，蛛丝的韧性之强，毒素侵蚀之诡异，那个结果本就在意料之中。

真正让他感到骇然的，是那隐藏在第二魂技之下、悄然蔓延开来的漆黑色纹路。

那种感觉……

古榕端着茶杯的手指微微收紧。

难道，是领域？

这个念头一旦冒出来就再也压不下去。一个魂帝就拥有了领域？

这简直是天方夜谭。可昨晚那一瞬间的窒息感和压迫力，骗不了人。

他活了这么多年，领域他见识过不止一种，那种特殊的感觉，他绝不会认错。

正思忖间，门外传来两道脚步声。

一重一轻，踩在走廊的木板上发出闷闷的响动。

敲了三下。

“进来。”

江蓠睁开眼，声音听不出半点刚睡醒的沙哑，像是已经醒了很久，只是在闭目养神。

门推开，进来两个人。

打头的是个精壮老头，须发皆白，一双手布满老茧和烫伤的疤痕——那是打了一辈子铁才有的印记。正是铁匠协会会长，神匠楼高。他身后跟着个魁梧汉子，面相憨厚，是副会长思龙。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Sleepless night.

When daylight broke, the entire Gengxin City had exploded.

The news that the side hall of Wuhun Palace was leaked spread like wildfire through every street.

Bishop Miles and the other three senior officials were neither alive nor dead, and not even a piece of clothing was pulled out of the fire.

Word spread faster than the wind.

Some people say it's an enemy seeking revenge, while others say it's retribution from heaven.There were different opinions for a while.

But no matter how the version changes, there is one thing that everyone understands tacitly——

The whole city was celebrating.

Almost everyone in the tea house and restaurant, including the storytellers, vegetable sellers and blacksmiths, had a bit of uncontrollable joy on their faces.

Over the years, I have been oppressed by Wuhun Palace, no, it should be said that it was Miles.

Now the big stone that was weighing on my heart suddenly disappeared, and the sense of relief almost came out of my bones.

But at the end of the hustle and bustle of the city, upstairs in the suburban inn, there was a completely different silence.

Gu Rong was sitting by the window, holding a cup of cold tea in his hand, and his eyes fell on the sleeping young man opposite.

Even though a whole night had passed, his thoughts still couldn't calm down.

He watched in the dark last night.

To deal with Miles, who is also the Soul Emperor, this kid only used his first and second soul skills in the whole process.The second soul skill controls the field, the first soul skill locks people, the toughness of the spider silk is strong, and the poisonous erosion is weird, the result is already expected.

What really shocked him was the dark lines hidden under the second soul skill that spread quietly.

That feeling...

Gu Rong's fingers holding the tea cup tightened slightly.

Could it be the field?

Once this idea comes up, it can no longer be suppressed.A soul emperor owns a domain?

This is simply a fantasy.But the suffocation and oppression at that moment last night could not be deceived.

He has lived for so many years and has seen more than one field. He will never admit that special feeling.

While I was thinking about it, there were two footsteps outside the door.

One heavy and one light, stepping on the wooden boards in the corridor made a muffled sound.

Knocked three times.

"Come in."

Jiang Li opened her eyes, and her voice was not hoarse at all from just waking up. It seemed that she had been awake for a long time and was just closing her eyes to rest.

The door opened and two people came in.

The one at the head was a strong old man, with white beard and hair, and his hands were covered with calluses and burn scars - the marks of a lifetime of hard work.He is the president of the Blacksmiths Association, the master craftsman Lou Gao.Behind him was a burly man with a simple and honest face, the vice-president Silong.
